high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed, featuring a post by the user "astronomiaxo." The post is titled "10TH DIMENSIONS" with a subtitle linking to another Instagram account, "thecosmologicalway." The visual content of the image is a surreal and imaginative depiction of a multiverse or higher-dimensional space. It features several large, transparent bubbles floating in a dark background, each containing different cosmic scenes. Inside one bubble, there is a depiction of a solar system with planets, a satellite, and a tree on a distant planet.
